name: Icicles
description: Icicles hanging from the top edge of a container; they lengthen slowly, drip, and snap when touched.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of icicles along the top edge.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Length of the longest icicle, in pixels. Leave at least this much room above the content.

props.name: drip
props.description: Let a drop form at the tip of an icicle now and then, fall and land on the bottom edge with a small ring. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the icicles. Style it as the card or panel they hang from. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the container. The icicles hang in front of it, so pad the top. Touching an icicle snaps it where you touch: it falls, shatters on the bottom edge and grows back.
